headline: AI APIs found 99% cheaper than premium options in extensive speed test
summary: A developer benchmarked 15 AI models, revealing some APIs offer comparable speed at up to 99% lower cost than popular premium alternatives, drastically cutting monthly bills.
details: A recent speed test revealed that some AI APIs are up to 99% cheaper than premium options, offering significant cost savings for developers. One model, Qwen3-8B, costs just $0.01 per million output tokens while still achieving 70 tokens per second.

The benchmark involved testing 15 different models on Time to First Token (TTFT) and sustained tokens-per-second output speed. This allowed for a direct comparison of performance and cost efficiency across the ecosystem.
Step-3.5-Flash emerged as a speed champion, delivering 80 tokens/second with a 120ms TTFT for $0.15/M. This represents a 95% cost reduction compared to a $3.00/M premium model.

DeepSeek V4 Flash hit a sweet spot at $0.25/M, offering 60 tokens/second and 180ms TTFT with quality comparable to GPT-4o. It's highlighted as a strong contender for general-purpose production work due to its cost-to-performance ratio.
For tasks not requiring maximum quality, models like Qwen3-8B provide competitive speed at a fraction of the cost. Generating 10 million tokens could cost $10 instead of $30,000 with premium options.

Switching from a $2/M model to DeepSeek V4 Flash could save around 87% on output costs for high-volume applications like chatbots. The findings emphasize that significant savings are possible without compromising user experience.
